{"consolidated_memory":"**Intermittent EOF in crypto/tls/handshake.go - Two Separate Incidents**

Both incidents involved unexpected end of stream errors during TLS negotiation in the security side of crypto/tls/handshake.go. Same corner of the codebase, but different root causes.

**Incident 1: [2026-01-28]**
- Trigger: Jobs scheduled across the midnight boundary
- Repro: Open many short-lived connections in a row
- Root cause: Race condition in lazy initialization
- Signal: Unexpected end of stream during negotiation
- Result: Memory settled at 803 MB instead of climbing past 3 GB
- Fix: Guarded the init with a double-checked lock
- PR #5617 on branch fix/intermittent-eof-2

**Incident 2: [2026-06-01]**
- Trigger: Only manifested for payloads above roughly two megabytes
- Repro: Open many short-lived connections in a row
- Root cause: Unbounded retry loop with no backoff
- Signal: Unexpected end of stream during negotiation
- Result: Job finished in 23 minutes instead of 4 hours
- Fix: Capped the retry attempts and added exponential backoff with jitter
- PR #7029 on branch fix/intermittent-eof-4

Both incidents occur in the same component and share the same repro pattern (many short-lived connections), but differ fundamentally in their triggers (midnight boundary vs large payloads), root causes (race condition vs retry loop), outcomes, and solutions."}
